# P36.56 — Scoped search forms on dossiers and source pages (K3 SRCH-06)

Manifest row 399 · Round 11 / P36 (sub-round 11C) · kind ticket · live_verification=false · Gate: none · no production mutation.

## What lands

- **`web/src/components/ScopedSearchForm.astro`** — the ONE scoped-search GET form: "Search within <place>" on every dossier (`jurisdiction=<jkey>` — the SIG-UI-059 descendants-inclusive contract parameter, pinned to the release's federated route with `format=html`) and "Search this source" on published source pages (`source=<id>`). Zero-JS complete — a plain `method="get"` form; honest variants for unkeyed dossiers (release-wide form with the absence stated), registry-only sources (no form), and a build with no activated release (named-empty).
- **`<sig-typeahead>` `scope` attribute** (`jurisdiction:<jkey>` / `source:<id>`) — narrows suggestions to the subtree or the named source; catalog place entries carry `jkey` + root-first ancestor `chain`, source entries `source_id`. Suggestions outside the scope never render; the no-JS path is untouched.
- **`web/src/lib/scoped-search.ts`** — the scope grammar + `jkeyParentMap`/`jkeyChain`/`jkeySubtree`: ancestry resolved through the `sig.jurisdiction-key-map/1` (export), each dossier's own `chain` field, and index `parent_jkey` links — a non-page intermediate (a below-threshold county) no longer truncates the chain.
- **Two matcher defects fixed in the same pass** (surfaced by the new e2e): `matchEntries`' alt fold no longer lets a non-matching `alt` (the bare code, e.g. "US") demote a label-matched entry — suggestions that were silently dropped on every mount now appear; and the ancestry walk reaches past non-page registry members.
- Mounts: dossier At a glance (after the Explore bar), source page after At a glance.
- Tests: 10 unit (`scoped-search.test.ts`) + 4 e2e (`scoped-search.spec.ts` — form contract, scope attribute, subtree suggestions, county key, source scope).

## Requirement ids

Owned: **SIG-UI-128** (every dossier carries a zero-JS GET search scoped to its jurisdiction and descendants, pinned to its release).
Cited: SIG-UI-039, SIG-UI-040, SIG-ENG-042, SIG-UI-059, SIG-UI-060, SIG-SRCH-009.

## Deferrals (recorded, never smoothed)

- **D-P36.56-1** (F): the v2 federated engine applies `jurisdiction=` leaf-exact (`records.place_key = ?`), not SIG-UI-059's "filter including descendants"; `within=`/`location=` are silently dropped on the v2 route (declared in `KNOWN_PARAMS_V2` but absent from the route signature + `parse_params_v2`). The forms emit the contract parameter; the engine expansion is owed by the search-engine row.
- **D-P36.56-2** (V): opened; **verified-met in-run** (status flip owed — register grammar needs a fresh status date) — the `/dossier/` +80 B wire-budget overage was reclaimed by re-compacting the shared `sig-typeahead.js` module and deduplicating the index script tag; `budget.spec.ts` measures under the ratified 174,080 B ceiling, so the `measured_gaps` row went stale per its own trigger and is removed (never a smoothed ceiling).
